## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the approved work.
- [ ] No ranch fact or business rule was invented.
- [ ] No blocking unknown was silently bypassed.
- [ ] Open domain questions were not silently resolved.
- [ ] Relevant UX implications were considered.
- [ ] Relevant domain/data semantics remain truthful.
- [ ] Relevant architecture decisions were respected.
- [ ] Future capabilities were not implemented opportunistically.
- [ ] Relevant validation/checks actually ran.
- [ ] Important accepted decisions discovered during the work were preserved in the correct repository artifact.
- [ ] Explicitly out-of-scope work remains out of scope.

For a meaningful change, apply `docs/product/definition-of-done.md` in proportion. Delivery rules are in `docs/development/github-workflow.md`.
